obligation_candidates.canon_label: Canonical Persona management belongs in Agent Config, while Settings is limited to cross-cutting runtime policy knobs.
exact_tokens: Canonical Persona management belongs in Agent Config as the primary owner surface, while Settings is limited to cross-cutting runtime policy knobs.

obligation_candidates.canon_label: Agent Config > Personas must provide the canonical Persona library and editing surface, including compatibility disclosure, requested-versus-effective preview, and one shared capability-and-availability presentation model across editor and runtime views.
exact_tokens: Agent Config > Personas must provide a real library surface with a list, filters or groups, a scope badge, prompt preview or editor, an effective runtime summary, provider compatibility disclosure, and a requested-versus-effective preview.
Persona editor and runtime surfaces need one shared capability-and-availability presentation model so they explain provider support, skipped controls, and fallback reasons consistently.

obligation_candidates.canon_label: Specialty Personas should support restore-to-default behavior after user modification.
exact_tokens: Specialty Personas should support restore-to-default behavior after user modification.
